title: 第21章 成为常役第22章 用心险恶
content_zh:
;;
青石铺就的下山路，陈平走得很快。
脚步踩在石阶上，发出笃笃的轻响，带着一种前所未有的沉稳。
身后杂役峰上王管事气急败坏的叫骂，和疤脸监工爬起来的呻吟声，渐渐被山风吹散。
他没有回头，也不需要回头。
那条路，他走够了。
山下的杂役管事处，是一座比山上王管事住处稍大些的石屋。
门口空地上，放着一个黝黑、沉重的石锁，旁边立着一块石碑，刻着“五百斤”三个字。
这便是常役弟子的入门门槛。
此刻，只有几个杂役在远处搬运杂物，管事处门口显得有些冷清。
一个穿着半旧管事服、头发花白的老者正坐在门槛上打盹，听到脚步声，抬起眼皮，浑浊的眼睛里没什么情绪。
“何事？”
老者声音干涩。
“弟子陈平，申请常役弟子考核。”
陈平站定，声音清晰。
老者上下打量了他几眼。
陈平身上是洗得发白的粗布短褂，身形依旧单薄，左臂的袖子挽起，露出的手臂细瘦，但能看到一层薄薄的肌肉线条。
他的脸上没什么血色，眼神却异常沉静，没有杂役惯有的畏缩或讨好。
“山上来的？”
老者问了一句废话，但语气平淡。

“是。”
“规矩知道？举石锁，过顶一次，稳住三息。”
老者指了指那块黝黑的石锁，又闭上了眼睛，似乎对结果并不关心。
杂役峰每年都有几个不自量力想来碰运气的，大多连石锁都撼不动。
陈平没再多话。
他走到石锁前。
石锁乌沉沉的，表面粗糙，分量感十足。
他蹲下身，双手稳稳握住冰冷的石锁把手。
触感粗糙，带着山石的冰凉和坚硬。
深吸一口气，腰腹发力，双腿如同扎根。
手臂上的肌肉瞬间绷紧，青筋在细瘦的皮肤下微微隆起。
“起！”
一声低喝，石锁应声离地！
石锁与地面摩擦发出的沉闷声响。
它被陈平稳稳地提到了腰间。
陈平动作没有停顿，腰背一挺，双臂灌注力量，那沉重的石锁被稳稳地托举起来，高过头顶！
手臂的肌肉在颤抖，骨骼承受着巨大的压力，发出细微的声响。
汗水立刻从他额角渗出，顺着脸颊滑落。
但他眼神专注，双臂如同铁铸，牢牢地支撑着这份远超过去的重量。
一息，两息，三息！

时间仿佛被拉长，又似乎只过了一瞬。
“哐当！”
陈平将石锁稳稳放回地面，发出一声沉重的闷响。
他直起身，胸膛微微起伏，呼吸有些急促，但站得笔直。
content_en:
;;
Chen Ping walked very quickly on the bluestone-paved road down the mountain.
The footsteps on the stone steps made a soft sound, with an unprecedented calmness.
Behind him, the angrily yelling of Steward Wang on the Handyman Peak, and the groans of the scar-faced supervisor getting up were gradually blown away by the mountain wind.
He didn't look back, and he didn't need to look back.
He has walked enough of that road.
The handyman's office at the foot of the mountain is a stone house slightly larger than the residence of the king's steward on the mountain.
In the open space at the door, there is a dark, heavy stone lock, and next to it is a stone tablet with the words "five hundred catties" engraved on it.
This is the entry threshold for regular disciples.
At this moment, there were only a few handymen carrying debris in the distance, and the entrance to the management office seemed a little deserted.
An old man with gray hair wearing a half-worn steward's uniform was sitting on the threshold and taking a nap. When he heard the footsteps, he raised his eyelids. There was no emotion in his cloudy eyes.
"What's the matter?"
The old man's voice was dry.
"Disciple Chen Ping, apply for the permanent disciple assessment."
Chen Ping stood still and his voice was clear.
The old man looked him up and down.
Chen Ping was wearing a coarse cloth jacket that had been washed white, and his figure was still thin. The sleeve of his left arm was rolled up, and the exposed arm was thin, but a thin layer of muscle lines could be seen.
There was no color on his face, but his eyes were unusually calm, without the usual shrinking or flattery of a handyman.
"Come from the mountain?"
The old man asked nonsense, but his tone was calm.
"Yes."
"Do you know the rules? Lift the stone lock, lift it over the top once, and hold it steady for three breaths."
The old man pointed at the dark stone lock and closed his eyes again, as if he didn't care about the result.
Every year, there are a few people who overestimate their abilities and try their luck at Zaiyue Peak, and most of them can't even shake the stone locks.
Chen Ping said nothing more.
He walked to the stone lock.
Shisuo is dark, rough in surface and full of weight.
He knelt down and firmly grasped the cold stone lock handle with both hands.
It feels rough to the touch, with the coldness and hardness of mountain rocks.
Take a deep breath, strengthen your waist and abdomen, and make your legs feel like they are rooted.
The muscles in his arms tensed instantly, and the veins bulged slightly under the thin skin.
"Get up!"
With a low cry, Shi Suo left the ground!
The stone lock made a dull sound as it rubbed against the ground.
It was lifted steadily to Chen Ping's waist.
Chen Ping didn't pause in his movements. He straightened his back and injected strength into his arms. The heavy stone lock was steadily lifted up and above his head!
The muscles of the arms were trembling, and the bones were under tremendous pressure, making a slight sound.
Sweat immediately seeped out from his forehead and slid down his cheeks.
But his eyes were focused, and his arms were like cast iron, firmly supporting this weight that was far greater than before.
One breath, two breaths, three breaths!
Time seemed to be stretched out, and it seemed like only a moment had passed.
"Clang!"
Chen Ping placed the stone lock firmly back on the ground, making a heavy muffled sound.
He stood up straight, his chest rising and falling slightly, his breathing a little rapid, but he stood up straight.
